contexts.text: To loathe husbands and sons () = to reject goods and truths.
I loathe my life () = no adjunction...
(Loathing excited by what is spiritual.) AC 2763:end.
(The internal sense loathed.)
To be affected with loathing () = aversion.
Unless it is tempered by such things, the good of celestial love... is loathed.
After a short time they loathe truths.
After some time they loathe work.
You were then in a state of loathing for the sex.
Hence comes loathing (in marriages). Explained.
Cold and fastidious.
This cold is followed by a certain fastidiousness which looks to nausea.
After unrestrained intercourse... they are overtaken by colds, loathings, and nausea; first for their consort, then for the rest, and at last for the sex.
They then loathe bed and chamber, nay the whole female sex, except girls.
They loathe the sex...
That this lust is love and at the same time loathing for the sex. Explained.
(The Societies of friendship cause Swedenborg to feel loathing for what he is reading in Genesis.)
He hath loathed the cities () = that they reject doctrine.
The desertion and vastation of the Church is meant by the laud being deserted and loathed ().
Occurs.
Loathing. Signified.
As prolification by adultery corresponds to the production of evil by falsity and of falsity from evil, its pleasure and delight... are at last turned into loathing and nausea.
